name: Kidney Care UK
description: The UK's leading kidney patient support charity. Offers free counselling, patient grants, financial advice, advocacy, and peer support.
eligibility: Anyone living with kidney disease, their family, or carers.

name: Kidney Research UK
description: Funding life-saving research into kidney health and providing evidence-based patient information booklets on early CKD, diet, and lifestyle.
eligibility: Open to all patients, researchers, and public.

name: NHS Talking Therapies (IAPT)
description: Free, confidential NHS psychological therapies for adults experiencing stress, anxiety, low mood, or managing emotional strain from long-term health conditions. Self-referral available without GP appointment.
eligibility: Aged 18+ registered with a GP in England.

name: Kidney Beam (Physical Activity & Wellbeing)
description: Clinically validated physical activity and emotional wellbeing platform designed specifically for people living with kidney disease. Free NHS-funded access across England.
eligibility: Anyone diagnosed with CKD stages 1-5, dialysis, or transplant.

name: Citizens Advice
description: Confidential, free advice on welfare benefits (PIP, Attendance Allowance), prescription charge exemptions, employment rights, and housing adaptations.
eligibility: Free and open to all UK residents.

name: MoneyHelper (UK Government Service)
description: Free, impartial government-backed money and pensions guidance, including travel insurance for pre-existing conditions and utility assistance schemes.
